any_of: New Business AFA Medical Cost Grid

extraction_notes:
This is an Aetna Small Group "New Business" proposal package (Medically Underwritten/AFA - Aetna Funding Advantage self-funded product) with three benefit categories: Medical, Dental, and Vision, plus a census grid and lengthy caveats/assumptions boilerplate (ignore for extraction purposes).

STRUCTURE:
1. Page 1-2: Cover + group info (Group Name, Broker, Quote #, Effective Date range, Run Date, group address, SIC, Total Eligible, AFA stop-loss details like ISL/ASL levels - these are self-funded stop-loss parameters, not per-plan benefit data).

2. MEDICAL - "New Business AFA Medical Cost Grid - Single Options" (pages 3-10 in this doc, ~106 plans total, all named "AFA CPOSII [deductible] [coins]/... CY V25"). Table columns: Plan Name/Plan ID | Ded/Co-ins,PCP/SPEC RX (combined field showing deductible, coinsurance split, PCP/Specialist copay, and Rx tier costs) | Network | EE | EE+SP | EE+CH | FAM | Total | Agg(TOTAL) | Stop Loss(TOTAL) | Admin(TOTAL) | TRO(TOTAL). 
   - The "EE/EE+SP/EE+CH/FAM/Total" columns are MONTHLY PREMIUM rates - note the parenthetical numbers under each rate (e.g. "(11)") are enrollment COUNTS per tier from the census, NOT part of the dollar value - strip these out when extracting rates.
   - The "Ded/Co-ins,PCP/SPEC RX" column packs deductible amount, coinsurance (in/out format like 100/0 or 80/20), PCP/Specialist copay, and pharmacy tier cost-share (e.g. "3/10/50/80/20% up to 250/40% up to 500") all in one comma/slash-delimited string - record verbatim into benefits map as "Deductible/Coins" and "Rx" fields since it's not further broken out in this doc type.
   - Only in-network figures given; no explicit OON, OOP max, or per-benefit-category (ER, PCP copay alone, etc.) breakdown provided beyond that packed string - do not invent OOP max/embedded deductible fields, leave blank/omit if not computable.
   - Agg/Stop Loss/Admin/TRO TOTAL columns are aggregate self-funded cost components (total across group), not per-member premium - can be ignored/omitted from standard schema or noted only if needed.
   - Plan count: exactly 106 individual medical plan rows across pages 3-10.

3. DENTAL - "New Business Dental Cost Grid" (pages 11-13). Similar layout: Plan Name/Plan ID | In-Network Benefits (Prev/Basic/Major %, Ded/Max Benefit/Ortho combined) | OON Benefits (Ded/Max Benefit/Ortho) | Network | EE/EE+SP/EE+CH/FAM/Total monthly rates (again with parenthetical enrollment counts to strip). Many plans come in pairs: a standard version and a "Vol" (voluntary) version with identical rates/benefits but different Plan ID - record BOTH as separate plans since they have distinct IDs, even though values match. 36 dental plan rows across pages 11-13.

4. VISION - "Aetna Vision Preferred Small Group Plans" (pages 15-16), completely different table format: a benefit-feature grid (Exam, Frame, Lenses, Contacts, etc.) by plan name (E100/E130/E160/E200), each with TWO rate columns (12M and 24M frame frequency options). Treat each Plan+frequency combination as a separate plan entry (i.e., E100-12M and E100-24M are distinct "plans" for extraction) - 4 plans x 2 frequencies = 8 vision plan entries. Rate tiers: Self/Self+Spouse/Self+Child(ren)/Self+Family monthly - map to employee_only/employee_spouse/employee_children/family.

5. Census Grid (pages 17-18) lists individual employees/dependents with DOB, tier, plan network - this is enrollment data, not benefit/plan data, do not extract as plans.

6. Pages 19-25 are boilerplate caveats/assumptions/legal disclaimers - no extractable plan data.

QUIRKS TO WATCH FOR NEXT TIME:
- Always strip the "(N)" enrollment count subscript from every rate cell.
- Medical plan Rx/deductible details are given as one packed string, not separate discrete benefit rows - don't try to force into separate ER/PCP/Specialist copay fields unless a future doc breaks it out explicitly.
- Dental "Vol" prefixed plans are voluntary versions of the immediately-preceding non-Vol plan; still separate rows with own Plan IDs - include both.
- Vision doc has no deductible/OOP max concept ("All plans have no deductible and no waiting periods") - omit those fields.
- Watch total plan counts: Medical ~106, Dental ~36, Vision 4 base plans x2 frequency = 8. Confirm none skipped given large row count spanning many pages.
- Quote ID, Group Name, Effective Date always repeated in header/footer of every page - reliable place to pull top-level fields.
